shorts.title: Is a Tiger's Skin Striped Too? 🐯
shorts.description:
Tigers aren't just striped on the fur. Shave one, and the skin underneath is striped too. No two tigers have the same stripe pattern.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Panthera tigris: CC0, Morten Ross (CC BY), Daniel Z (CC BY). creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 · creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0
shorts.comment: Who else thought it was just the fur? 👇

shorts.title: Can a Cockroach Really Live Without Its Head? 🪳
shorts.description:
A cockroach can live for a week without its head. That's not a myth. That's a cockroach. Cockroaches can hold their breath for around forty minutes.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Periplaneta americana: Steve Kerr (CC BY), CC0. creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 · creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0
shorts.comment: Have you ever seen one keep going after you hit it? 👇
